# Monke

> Free, client-only, grammar-based random word generator for conlang (constructed language) creators. Runs entirely in the browser; grammars are shared via URL and never stored on a server.

Monke builds words from named rules: terminal rules list sounds, pattern rules combine them with a small syntax (quoted text, rule references, `.` sequence, `/` choice, `*N` weights, `(x)` optionals, `[x]` groups, `{min:max}` repetition). Rewrites with back-references model sound changes; exclusions reject unwanted outputs. It imports Awkwords patterns.

## Docs

- [Reference](https://monke.lunah.dev/reference/): pattern syntax, weights, rewrites, back-references, exclusions, word boundaries, seeds, sharing, and recipes
- [FAQ](https://monke.lunah.dev/faq/): what Monke is, where grammars are saved, feedback
- [Coming from Awkwords](https://monke.lunah.dev/awkwords-alternative/): importing Awkwords patterns and the syntax mapping
- [Full text](https://monke.lunah.dev/llms-full.txt): all of the above in one file
